urban_version_protocol.scope: Object-level physical attachment, compatibility and uninstall-acceptance contract for 100D plug-ins; not an annual city ledger, general service receipt, source-control metaphor or statutory approval.
urban_version_protocol.dependency_rule: A 100D object cannot touch or create proprietary anchors in the 100Y base; it must type-check through one named 10Y carrier_interface_id.
urban_version_protocol.uninstall_rule: ROLLBACK closes only after a named human accepts asset/data portability and physical site restoration against the pre-release baseline.
urban_version_protocol.authority: Humans retain RELEASE, PAUSE and EXIT authority. No plug-in may bypass the 10Y carrier or overwrite slower public layers.

scenarios.purpose_zh: 验证低速配送、巡检、清扫机器人在真实公共空间中的可达性、安全性与退出能力；测试结果不构成产品准入、监管认证或日常运营批准。
scenarios.purpose_en: Test accessibility, safety and exit capacity of low-speed delivery, inspection and cleaning robots in a real public-space setting; results are not product approval, regulatory certification or permission for routine operation.
scenarios.users_zh: 研发工程师、测试员、场地运维、安全专业人员、受邀公众观察者
scenarios.users_en: engineers, test staff, operators, safety professionals and invited public observers
scenarios.location_zh: 众智园 Prototype Bay；连接中关村科技服务翼；确切位置待红线、权属与安全距离核验
scenarios.location_en: Prototype Bay at Zhongzhiyuan, linked to the Zhongguancun Technology Service Wing; exact siting awaits boundary, tenure and safety checks
scenarios.spatial_type_zh: 可封闭、分时开放的模块化硬质场地，含缓冲区、人工观察位与无障碍绕行线
scenarios.spatial_type_en: a closable, time-shared modular hardscape with buffers, staffed observation and an accessible bypass
scenarios.lifecycle_zh: 100Y层保留公共通行和安全底线；10Y层提供可变铺装及通用接口；100D层为机器人、充电和测试设施
scenarios.lifecycle_en: the 100Y layer protects public passage and safety; the 10Y layer provides adjustable paving and common interfaces; robots, chargers and test fixtures are 100D
scenarios.ai_role_zh: 导航、避障、任务调度与仿真；不得替代现场安全主管或应急处置人员
scenarios.ai_role_en: navigation, avoidance, scheduling and simulation, never the on-site safety lead or emergency staff
scenarios.data_zh: 设备轨迹、速度、故障码、环境传感、事件记录；视频只在必要范围启用
scenarios.data_en: device trajectories, speed, fault codes, environmental sensing and incident records; video only where necessary
scenarios.personal_data_zh: 可能涉及影像和位置；默认去识别、最小留存并设置不采集观察区
scenarios.personal_data_en: images and location may be involved; default de-identification, minimum retention and observation zones without capture
scenarios.accountable_zh: 测试场安全负责人和每台设备的测试负责人共同签署放行
scenarios.accountable_en: joint sign-off by the yard safety lead and each device test lead
scenarios.preconditions_zh: 围界与疏散审查、地理围栏、急停测试、公众告知、保险、无障碍绕行、消防与电气核验
scenarios.preconditions_en: enclosure and egress review, geofence, emergency-stop test, public notice, insurance, accessible bypass, fire and electrical checks
scenarios.audit_zh: 记录版本、任务、人工接管、碰撞/近失事件、投诉与整改，且原记录不可覆盖
scenarios.audit_en: immutable records of version, task, takeover, collision or near miss, complaints and correction
scenarios.pause_zh: 急停失效、越界、人员冲突、未授权采集、恶劣天气或安全主管指令
scenarios.pause_en: failed emergency stop, boundary breach, human conflict, unauthorised collection, severe weather or safety-lead instruction
scenarios.rollback_zh: 立即停机断电，撤出设备和临时充电模块，封存日志；未通过者不得转为日常运营
scenarios.rollback_en: stop and isolate power, remove devices and temporary charging, preserve logs; failed tests cannot become routine services
scenarios.restoration_zh: 拆除锚固件，恢复模块铺装、排水、绿化边缘与连续通行
scenarios.restoration_en: remove anchors and restore modular paving, drainage, planted edges and continuous passage
scenarios.metrics_zh: 测试小时、每千测试小时安全事件、人工接管成功率、急停响应、复原时间、整改闭环率
scenarios.metrics_en: test hours, incidents per 1,000 test hours, takeover success, stop response, restoration time and closure rate
scenarios.missing_zh: 道路及产权边界、地下管线、应急通道、背景人流与噪声基线
scenarios.missing_en: road and tenure boundaries, utilities, emergency access, baseline footfall and noise
scenarios.follow_up_zh: 交通、安全工程、机器人测试、消防、电气、无障碍与保险联合审查
scenarios.follow_up_en: joint review by transport, safety engineering, robotics testing, fire, electrical, accessibility and insurance specialists
scenarios.interface_envelope_zh: 由C01/C02/C03/C07/C08组成概念载体；结构荷载、电力、数据、无障碍净宽、噪声与消防六类上限须在RELEASE前由专业人员实测并写入，不以概念值放行
scenarios.interface_envelope_en: concept carrier formed by C01/C02/C03/C07/C08; structural load, power, data, accessible clearance, noise and fire limits must be measured and entered by professionals before RELEASE, never inferred from concept values
scenarios.base_impact_budget_zh: 100Y底盘上的专有直接锚固许可为零；全部可预见磨损、开孔、接驳与恢复责任由具名10Y载体承接，真实扰动量待现状基线和施工方法核验
scenarios.base_impact_budget_en: zero allowance for proprietary direct anchors in the 100Y base; the named 10Y carrier absorbs foreseeable wear, penetrations, connections and restoration duty, while actual disturbance awaits a surveyed baseline and method statement
scenarios.portability_zh: 退场前导出经授权数据和配置、移交或回收资产与备件、撤销凭据、封闭端口，并保留可复核清单
scenarios.portability_en: before exit, export authorised data and configuration, transfer or recover assets and spares, revoke credentials, cap ports and retain a reviewable inventory
scenarios.restoration_acceptance_zh: 只有具名人类验收人依据启用前基线与退场证据确认铺装、排水、绿化、通行、实体服务和遗产界面恢复，对象才可由ROLLBACK转入ARCHIVE/REUSE
scenarios.restoration_acceptance_en: the object may move from ROLLBACK to ARCHIVE/REUSE only after a named human compares the pre-release baseline and exit evidence and accepts reinstatement of paving, drainage, planting, passage, staffed service and heritage interfaces

scenarios.pause_zh: 泄露敏感信息、持续误导、歧视性结果、越权建议或无法人工接管

scenarios.restoration_zh: 终端撤出后恢复为普通公共服务或教学空间

scenarios.metrics_zh: 测试案例数、失败类别覆盖、人工接管成功率、纠错闭环时间、撤回履行率、无障碍任务成功率

scenarios.purpose_zh: 验证本地计算、传感和城市家具接口的耐久性、隐私边界与可维护性；不构成市政定型或采购批准。

scenarios.lifecycle_zh: 100Y层保持公共空间连续；10Y层为家具基座和管线接口；100D层为传感器、边缘盒与交互模块

scenarios.ai_role_zh: 本地环境识别、匿名流量估计与设备诊断；不得执法或身份识别

scenarios.personal_data_zh: 原则上不采集；如不可避免，须单独评估、明显提示并缩短留存
scenarios.personal_data_en: normally none; unavoidable collection requires separate assessment, conspicuous notice and short retention
scenarios.accountable_zh: 市政设施运营人及试验设备负责人
scenarios.accountable_en: municipal facility operator and test-device owner
scenarios.preconditions_zh: 结构、电气、网络安全、无障碍净宽、隐私告知、维护和断电方案通过审查

scenarios.restoration_zh: 恢复原家具功能、铺装完整、排水与无障碍净宽
scenarios.restoration_en: restore ordinary furniture function, paving, drainage and accessible clearance
scenarios.metrics_zh: 本地处理比例、未授权外传、故障率、维护响应、移除时间、通行阻碍事件
scenarios.metrics_en: on-device share, unauthorised transfer, failure rate, maintenance response, removal time and obstruction incidents
scenarios.missing_zh: 管线、设施权属、客流、微气候、既有家具标准与维护责任
scenarios.missing_en: utilities, asset ownership, footfall, microclimate, furniture standards and maintenance duties
scenarios.follow_up_zh: 工业设计、结构、电气、网络安全、景观、隐私与无障碍复核

scenarios.purpose_zh: 提供模型原理、局限、开源工具和城市问题实践课程。
scenarios.purpose_en: Teach model principles, limits, open tools and urban problem practice.
scenarios.users_zh: 学生、青年开发者、教师、居民学习者
scenarios.users_en: students, young developers, teachers and resident learners
scenarios.location_zh: 北京AI原点社区 Co-Creation Bay；服务中关村科技服务翼

scenarios.spatial_type_en: reconfigurable classroom, workshop and small compute-demonstration room
scenarios.lifecycle_zh: 100Y层保障公共教育机会；10Y层为共享课堂；100D层为课程、模型和终端
scenarios.lifecycle_en: 100Y protects public learning; the shared classroom is 10Y; curricula, models and terminals are 100D
scenarios.ai_role_zh: 教学助理、代码提示和模拟；不得替代教师评价、未成年人监护或价值判断

scenarios.missing_en: age profile, demand, capacity, network/compute, school partners and guardianship
scenarios.follow_up_zh: 教育、儿童保护、版权、AI安全与无障碍专家共同制定标准
scenarios.follow_up_en: education, child protection, copyright, AI safety and accessibility specialists to set standards

personas.rights_zh: 最小权限、完整日志、人工覆盖与退出后可运维

landmarks.desc_zh: 非纪念碑式可拆测试门架，公开插件ID、版本、状态、人类负责人和急停位置；门架为10Y、设备为100D，位置/跨度/基础/荷载待核验。
landmarks.desc_en: A demountable, non-monumental test gantry displaying plug-in ID, version, status, accountable human and emergency stop. The gantry is 10Y, equipment is 100D, and siting/span/foundation/load await review.

landmarks.bay_zh: 北京AI原点社区 / Co-Creation Bay
landmarks.bay_en: Beijing AI Origin Community / Co-Creation Bay
landmarks.desc_zh: 公众议事、模型审计、开放课堂、发布与纠错的适应性公共空间；优先既有建筑再利用，产权、容量、消防与改造价值待调查。
landmarks.desc_en: An adaptable public room for deliberation, model audit, open learning, release and correction. Prioritise adaptive reuse; tenure, capacity, fire and reuse value await survey.

landmarks.desc_zh: 模块接驳、检测、维修、储运和回收节点，形成到场—验收—运行—退场—复原闭环；规模服从道路、噪声、消防、历史环境和公共空间容量。
landmarks.desc_en: A module docking, inspection, repair, storage, return and recovery node closing the arrival–acceptance–operation–exit–restoration loop; scale follows transport, noise, fire, heritage and public-space capacity.

components.rule_zh: 优先压载或可逆连接；拆除后封闭接口并恢复铺装
components.rule_en: Prefer ballast or reversible joints; cap interfaces and reinstate paving after removal

components.rule_zh: 标准数电接驳、独立计量、物理断电、端口登记
components.rule_en: Standard power/data docking, separate metering, physical isolation and a port register

components.rule_zh: 保证净宽、坡度、防滑和退场后高程连续
components.rule_en: Protect clear width, gradient and slip resistance; reinstate continuous levels at exit

components.rule_zh: 逐次核验风荷载与消防，构件回库复用
components.rule_en: Review wind and fire for every deployment; return components for reuse

components.rule_zh: 形成私密性但不制造危险死角
components.rule_en: Provide privacy without creating unsafe blind corners

components.rule_zh: 标识数据流、物理急停和设备可更换
components.rule_en: Label data flows, provide physical stop and keep equipment replaceable

components.rule_zh: 开放接口文档、隔离保护与停用封帽
components.rule_en: Publish interface documents, isolate safely and cap unused ports

components.rule_zh: 人工优先、离线可用、动作留痕
components.rule_en: Give people priority, work offline and log every intervention

components.rule_zh: 不随插件下线并定期人工核验
components.rule_en: Remain when a plug-in is offline and receive scheduled human checks

components.rule_zh: 编号回装、减少开挖并保持排水连续
components.rule_en: Number parts for reinstatement, reduce excavation and maintain drainage

components.rule_zh: 在土壤排水核验后采用并保持溢流安全
components.rule_en: Use only after soil/drainage checks and retain safe overflow

components.rule_zh: 只展示已审定信息，构件可迁移
components.rule_en: Display reviewed information only and keep the assembly relocatable

components.rule_zh: 核心功能离线可用，智能件独立拆除
components.rule_en: Keep core furniture usable offline and remove smart parts independently

components.rule_zh: 逐次核验结构、电气和人群容量
components.rule_en: Review structure, electrical safety and crowd capacity for every use

components.rule_zh: 防火分区、资产台账与污染物分类处理
components.rule_en: Provide fire separation, an asset ledger and classified contaminant handling

global_cases.status_zh: JTC总体规划开发；SIT校区已启用，园区渐进运营；2026实体AI试验场仍属计划启动状态。
global_cases.mechanism_zh: 城区数字底座—虚拟测试—受控实地试验，数据分级授权。
global_cases.transfer_zh: 把数字底座、仿真与实测分成三级；接口共用但数据不默认开放。
global_cases.limit_zh: 土地统筹、监管与20,000+传感器规模不可移植。
global_cases.status_en: JTC master-planned development; SIT is open and the district is entering operation, while the 2026 physical-AI testbed was still announced for later launch.
global_cases.mechanism_en: District digital base, virtual test and controlled field test with tiered data access.
global_cases.transfer_en: Separate digital base, simulation and field release; share interfaces without default data openness.
global_cases.limit_en: Singapore land/regulatory integration and reported sensor scale are not transferable targets.

global_cases.status_zh: 2000年起渐进更新，2022再修编、2023更新基础设施规划；南区较成熟、北区仍发展。
global_cases.mechanism_zh: 知识型生产、居住、设施和公共空间混合，并随阶段校准基础设施。
global_cases.transfer_zh: 增量开发同步锁定公共空间、服务与基础设施责任。
global_cases.limit_zh: 加泰罗尼亚开发权与价值回收制度、历史比例不可套用。
global_cases.status_en: Incremental renewal since 2000, amended in 2022 with a 2023 infrastructure plan; the south is more consolidated while the north remains in development.
global_cases.mechanism_en: Mixed knowledge production, housing, facilities and public space with infrastructure recalibrated by phase.
global_cases.transfer_en: Tie each increment to public-space, service and infrastructure obligations.
global_cases.limit_en: Catalan planning law and historic development-right ratios cannot become Beijing controls.

global_cases.zh: Brainport / 埃因霍温高科技园
global_cases.status_zh: 成熟研发园区持续运营；区域战略、执行机构与园区现场管理分层。
global_cases.mechanism_zh: 企业—知识机构—政府三方区域治理，加专业园区运营与共享设施。
global_cases.transfer_zh: 公共战略委员会、专业执行机构与现场运营团队分责。
global_cases.limit_zh: 私营专业园区不是完整混合城市，开放创新不等于无条件开放IP。
global_cases.status_en: A mature R&D campus with separate layers for regional strategy, execution and on-site management.
global_cases.mechanism_en: Triple-Helix regional governance, a professional delivery body and shared-site operations.
global_cases.transfer_en: Separate civic-interest strategy, technically capable execution and daily operations.
global_cases.limit_en: A privately managed specialist campus is not a complete mixed city; open innovation is not unconditional IP openness.

global_cases.status_zh: Phase 1已启动、Phase 2仍建设；居民和项目样本仍小，属公司治理的受控试验城。
global_cases.mechanism_zh: 原型车库—受控验证—真实居住环境的分级测试链。
global_cases.transfer_zh: 每插件配置原型、封闭测试、限定街区试运行、复盘扩展。
global_cases.limit_zh: 运营方自报、样本有限，不能视作长期独立成效。
global_cases.status_en: Phase 1 has begun while Phase 2 remains under construction; the resident/project sample is small and company-governed.
global_cases.mechanism_en: Prototype garage, controlled field and lived-environment test sequence.
global_cases.transfer_en: Give each plug-in a prototype, closed test, limited street trial and evidence-led expansion path.
global_cases.limit_en: Operator-reported small samples are not independent long-term evidence.

global_cases.status_zh: 2013—2021项目已结束，25个敏捷试验的方法被后续城市项目延用。
global_cases.mechanism_zh: 公开征集—共同开发—真实环境试用—评估；允许快速识别死路。
global_cases.transfer_zh: 百日批次预先声明日落、评估、资产去向，失败也归档。
global_cases.limit_zh: 芬兰试验常约六个月，采购与欧盟资助背景不同。
global_cases.status_en: The 2013-2021 programme ended after 25 agile pilots, while its method continues in later city programmes.
global_cases.mechanism_en: Open call, co-development, real-world trial and evaluation, including rapid identification of dead ends.
global_cases.transfer_en: Predeclare sunset, review and asset destination; archive failures as public learning.
global_cases.limit_en: Finnish pilots were often around six months and used different procurement/funding systems.

global_cases.status_zh: Sidewalk Labs于2020退出，原方案未建成；后续Quayside是另一个开发进程。
global_cases.mechanism_zh: 正式审查暴露实施责任、数据流、采购、技术失败、维护升级与最低可行方案的不足。
global_cases.transfer_zh: 平台之前先锁定公共权力、数据分类、采购责任、独立监督和供应商退出。
global_cases.limit_zh: 不能把隐私争议写成退出的单一直接原因。
global_cases.status_en: Sidewalk Labs withdrew in 2020 and that plan was not built; the later Quayside process is distinct.
global_cases.mechanism_en: Formal reviews exposed gaps in accountability, data flows, procurement, fallback, maintenance and minimum viable alternatives.
global_cases.transfer_en: Set public authority, data classes, procurement responsibility, independent oversight and vendor exit before choosing a platform.
global_cases.limit_en: Privacy controversy cannot be asserted as the single direct cause of withdrawal.

projects.description_en: Create a time-shared, closable and restorable test ground with the Prototype Gantry

phasing.description_zh: 核验边界、产权、遗产、道路、建筑、管线、设施、控规与安全条件。
phasing.description_en: Verify boundaries, tenure, heritage, roads, buildings, utilities, facilities, planning controls and safety conditions

phasing.description_zh: 只实施无需永久结构改变、可人工回退且不妨碍公众权利的临时导览、课堂与封闭测试。

phasing.description_zh: 逐步接入12场景，联动两翼并运行年度版本制度。
phasing.description_en: Connect twelve scenarios in stages, link both wings and operate a periodic public release process

phasing.description_zh: 据证据继续、升级、暂停、移除或复用，完成物理复原与发布说明。
phasing.description_en: Use evidence to continue, upgrade, pause, remove or reuse; complete physical restoration and public release notes
